skill.summary: Post content, read engagement, manage comments and messages, and view insights on Facebook Pages — powered by ClawLink.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the facebook-pages skill.
- Enables posting, managing comments/messages, and viewing insights on Facebook Pages via ClawLink integration.
- Provides step-by-step setup and usage instructions for connecting ClawLink and Facebook.
- Lists supported Facebook Page management tasks and outlines important usage rules.
- Includes troubleshooting and resource links for additional help.
